digest.component_or_area: Reconciler outcome lifecycle and manifest rendering
propositions: Versioned lifecycle, retry, and fuse outcome sections must be finalized with exact pass tallies, cursor advancement, and redacted diagnostics while preserving existing mutation field hashes and array bytes.

State advancement (cursor, baseline, binding, last-pass) must occur only after proven postconditions; deferred, failed, skipped, and commit_unknown work must remain eligible for re-observation and not be counted as applied.

The repair_at_write_boundary call must remain positioned after under-lock staleness validation (ensure_selection_current) and before the first remote issue fetch to prevent races between tombstone retirement intent and fresh remote observation.
Mutations must be accounted in disjoint buckets (applied, failed, deferred, skipped, recovered) with exact tallies that exclude double-counting of recovered outcomes in applied.
Logs and manifests must contain no secrets and all diagnostic fields and collections must be bounded.
